task: Deliver comment schema and shared serializer as Phase 5A, stacked above Phase 4K PR #59.
acceptanceCriteria: The reversible comments migration and TypeORM entity use an integer identity ID, required body/article/author fields, cascading article and author foreign keys, timestamps, and an index ordered by article_id, created_at, and id.
The shared comment serializer returns only the OpenAPI comment fields and public author profile fields, with author following state supplied separately.
Phase 5A adds no comment HTTP API route; the migration applies and reverts cleanly on TEST_DATABASE_URL.
blastRadius: TypeORM entity metadata and migration registry
contracts: one foundation PR with no endpoint, based on Phase 4K PR #59
comment ID is integer as specified by OpenAPI
serialized author contains bio, following, image, and username only
